# BetaTree

## Overview

This R package constructs a Beta-tree histogram for multivariate data by
growing a k-d tree on the order statistics, computing simultaneous
confidence bounds for the average density in each region, and selecting
the largest regions where the data are approximately uniform. The
Beta-tree histogram provides a succinct description of the data, as well
as simultaneous confidence intervals for the average density in each
region.

## Getting started

- Package website: <https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/>
- You can find the package **vignettes** under the Articles tab.
- You can read more about the Beta Tree histogram in the paper.

## Installation

You can install the package using

``` r
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("zq00/BetaTree")
```

## Function documentation

You can find the function documentations under the Reference tab. To get
started, you can take a look at the function
[`BuildHist()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/BuildHist.md),
which computes a Beta tree histogram.

## Source code

The source code is located at the [Github -\>
R](https://github.com/zq00/BetaTree/tree/main/R) folder.

## Feedback

If you encounter error or would like to provide feedback, please use
[Github -\> Issues](https://github.com/zq00/BetaTree/issues) to reach
us. Thank you!

# Package index

## All functions

- [`BuildHist()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/BuildHist.md)
  : Build a Beta-tree histogram
- [`BuildKDTree()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/BuildKDTree.md)
  : Build a k-d tree
- [`ConfLevel()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/ConfLevel.md)
  : Set significance level for regions at each tree depth
- [`FindModes()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/FindModes.md)
  : Identifies distinct modes in Beta-trees histogram
- [`FindModesApproximate()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/FindModesApproximate.md)
  : Identify Modes in a Beta-tree Histogram via Monte Carlo
  approximation
- [`PlotHist()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/PlotHist.md)
  : Plot a 2D Beta tree histogram
- [`SelectNodes()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/SelectNodes.md)
  : Select nodes in the histogram
- [`SetBounds()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/SetBounds.md)
  : Add confidence bounds to bounded regions in the k-d tree
- [`build_adaptive_histogram()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/build_adaptive_histogram.md)
  : Build an Adaptive Beta-Tree Histogram
- [`compute_adjacency_mat()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/compute_adjacency_mat.md)
  : Compute the adjacency matrix of regions in the histogram
- [`connected_to_modes()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/connected_to_modes.md)
  : Is a Region a Distinct Mode? (Approximate Algorithm)
- [`find_neighbors()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/find_neighbors.md)
  : Find Regions in the Neighborhood of a Mode
- [`get_partition_dim()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/get_partition_dim.md)
  : Choose Partition Dimension
- [`is_connected()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/is_connected.md)
  : Are two regions distinct modes?
- [`plot_histogram()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/plot_histogram.md)
  : Plot a multivariate histogram in two dimensions
- [`plot_histogram_data()`](https://zq00.github.io/BetaTree/reference/plot_histogram_data.md)
  : Prepare data for visualizing a multivariate histogram in two chosen
  dimensions
